# onetsolutions_hosting_subdomains (Data Source)

Lists the subdomains of a web hosting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_web_hosting" "site" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

data "onetsolutions_hosting_subdomains" "site" {
  hosting_id = data.onetsolutions_web_hosting.site.id
}

output "subdomains" {
  value = data.onetsolutions_hosting_subdomains.site.subdomains[*].full_domain
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hosting_id` (String) The UUID of the web hosting to read from.

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) The organization to read from. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id`.
- `project_id` (String) The project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `subdomains` (Attributes List) The subdomains. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subdomains))

<a id="nestedatt--subdomains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subdomains`

Read-Only:

- `domain` (String) The main domain of the web hosting.
- `full_domain` (String) The full domain name, such as `blog.example.com`.
- `subdomain` (String) The subdomain, without the main domain.
